info.name: List all data sources

params.name: search
params.description: Search term for data sources.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by data source type.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Order by field and direction. Prefix field name with '+' for ascending or '-' for descending order. Allowed fields: createdAt, lastIndexedAt, usageCount.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of data sources associated which the user has access to.

info.name: Refresh a Data Source

params.name: dataSourceId
params.description: The unique identifier of the data source to be refreshed.

params.name: forceRefresh
params.description: Indicates if the data source should be refreshed even if the content has not been updated

items.docs: This endpoint refreshes the specified data source.
